move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For your information:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We have reviewed your data regarding the cost model, delivery performance, and demand forecast.
While company policy currently restricts base price reductions, we can offer a price adjustment to €432.15 based on the extended 36-month contract term and 90-day payment period you proposed.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your data regarding the cost model, delivery performance, and demand forecast. While company policy currently restricts base price reductions, we can offer a price adjustment to €432.15 based on the extended 36-month contract term and 90-day payment period you proposed. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken.
We can commit to 4,580 pieces per year over 36 months, as set out in our proposal below.
We understand that your price is fixed for now, so we have looked at the terms instead.

One more point from our side:
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 per unit (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have verified the historical purchase order data you provided. However, as previously communicated, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. We have already factored the 36-month contract term and 90-day payment period into our offer of €432.15, which we must maintain. Our current offer comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
